grid.partition_rule: equal integer grid partitions: x=[floor(1536*c/8), floor(1536*(c+1)/8)); y=[floor(1024*r/5), floor(1024*(r+1)/5))

source_contract.placement: Each active cell contains one complete character pose, bottom-centered inside its own cell, with both feet readable and no clipping. All unused cells are flat pure chroma magenta.
source_contract.direct_authorship: Every listed source sheet is an independently authored direct view. It must not be a mirror, recolor, rotation, translation, diagonal composite, or derivation of another direction.

derived_direction_contract.west: exact horizontal pixel mirror of east only
derived_direction_contract.southwest: exact horizontal pixel mirror of southeast only
derived_direction_contract.northwest: exact horizontal pixel mirror of northeast only

allowed_operations: pure or near chroma-magenta removal to binary alpha
exact horizontal pixel mirror for west, southwest, and northwest only
exact active-frame pixel copy from v001 idle, hit, and death rows only
transparent atlas packing and deterministic PNG encoding
forbidden_operations: derive any of the five direct directions
synthesizing, repeating, or filling missing active frames
using v001 Move or attack rows

shared_visual_constraints: Create original production-ready 2D pixel art for the fixed-camera three-quarter top-down dark-fantasy dungeon game. Use the supplied role reference and v001 south sprite as binding design references: preserve role silhouette, costume, palette family, body proportions, foot baseline, upper-left lighting, and readable fixed-camera perspective. Crisp hand-placed pixel clusters only: hard edges, no antialiasing, no blur, no smooth vector lines, no painterly rendering, and no photorealism. Render one strict 1536x1024 source PNG with an exact 8-column by 5-row grid and no gutters, borders, panel labels, grid lines, text, letters, numbers, logos, signatures, or watermark. The whole background and every unused cell must be uniform #FF00FF chroma magenta; never use magenta in a character. Every active frame must be visibly authored and distinct enough to convey its row action. No ground plane, cast shadow, glow spill, particles, projectile, detached weapon, telegraph, duplicate character, alternate costume, or effect may cross a cell boundary.

provenance.status: record with the real generated source
